title: Cardiovascular & Stroke Care Guidance
source: WHO South Asia CVD Risk Guidelines & ACC/AHA Primary Prevention Guidelines
reviewed_by: Dr. R. Mehta, DM (Cardiology Review Board)

doctor_tests: Routine primary care screening every 6–12 months
Periodic blood pressure and lipid check
exercise: Include flexibility and light strength training
food: Heart-healthy diet rich in vegetables, fruits, whole grains, and nuts
Keep sodium <5 g/day and avoid trans fats
low.hospital_guidance: Primary care clinic or preventive health center.

doctor_tests: 12-lead ECG, Echocardiogram, and Fasting Lipid Profile
exercise: Moderate walking 30 min/day, 5 days/week after baseline BP check
Stop immediately if chest discomfort or dizziness occurs
food: Increase soluble fiber and omega-3 rich foods
moderate.hospital_guidance: Hospital with ECG, Echocardiography, and Cardiology OPD.

doctor_tests: 12-lead ECG, Echocardiogram, Lipid Profile, and physician-supervised stress evaluation
exercise: Get medical clearance first before starting or increasing any exercise program.
Avoid strenuous exertion until cleared by a cardiologist.
food: Strict sodium restriction and elimination of fried/processed foods
Clinical dietitian review for cardioprotective nutrition
high.hospital_guidance: 24x7 emergency-capable hospital with Cath Lab, ECG, Echo, and Cardiac ICU.
